objects.original: Real normed spaces E and F, an ambient C² function on a compact set K, its second-order Taylor residual, tolerance ε, and a uniform radius δ.
objects.reconstructed: Real normed vector spaces E,F; function f:E→F; compact set K⊆E; tolerance epsilon; uniform radius delta; second-order Taylor remainder.

domains.original: Real normed spaces E,F; E locally compact; compact K possibly empty. No completeness requirement is imposed on F; x+v is not required to lie in K.
domains.reconstructed: E,F are normed additive commutative groups and real normed vector spaces; E is locally compact. No completeness of E or F is explicitly assumed. epsilon,delta∈R.

assumptions.original: Let E and F be real normed vector spaces. Derivatives are real Fréchet derivatives; D²f(x) is viewed as a continuous bilinear map. E is locally compact, K⊆E is compact, and f is C² at every point of K. The set K may be empty.
assumptions.reconstructed: Assumptions: K compact; ambient ContDiffAt R 2 f x at each x∈K; epsilon>0.

conclusion.original: For every ε>0, there is one radius δ>0 that controls the second-order residual for every starting point x in K and every increment with norm less than δ. Formula: \forall\varepsilon>0\ \exists\delta>0\ \forall x\in K\ \forall\|v\|<\delta,\quad\|R_f(x,v)\|\le\varepsilon\|v\|^2.
conclusion.reconstructed: Conclusion: With R_f(x,v)=f(x+v)-f(x)-Df(x)[v]-(1/2)·D²f(x)[v,v], one has ||R_f(x,v)||≤epsilon ||v||² whenever x∈K and ||v||<delta.

quantifiers.original: For every f,K satisfying the smoothness and compactness hypotheses, and every ε>0, there exists δ>0 working for every x∈K and every v with norm below δ.
quantifiers.reconstructed: Quantifier order: For every f,K with K compact and f C² at every x∈K, and every epsilon>0, there exists delta>0 such that for every x∈K and every v∈E with ||v||<delta the bound holds.

scopes.original: Uniform in x∈K and all sufficiently small directions v; strict radius, non-strict quadratic residual bound; ambient differentiability at K.
scopes.reconstructed: Scope: Uniform in x∈K and all sufficiently small directions v. No requirement x+v∈K. Strict radius condition and non-strict remainder bound.

constant_dependencies.original: δ may depend on E,F,f,K and ε but not on x or v.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Constant dependencies: delta is chosen after E,F,f,K,epsilon and their structure/proof data; it may depend on these, but is independent of x and v.

module_audit.proof_route: Use an open C² locus and a compact thickening of K. Uniform Hessian continuity gives one oscillation radius. Every short segment remains inside the thickening; the preceding segment estimate controls the residual. The preceding estimate uses derivative/mean-value control without an unlisted completeness assumption.
